sections.Profile:
Lady Luck and Fortune , both produced by Recel S.A. in 1976, are electro-mechanical pinball machines sharing similar features but catering to different player formats. Lady Luck is a four-player machine, while Fortune is its one-player counterpart.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Dual Theme, Arts & Entertainment, Gambling, Dancing, Nightlife, Original Theme, 1970s
